recipes.name: Tahini Vinaigrette Dressing
instructions: Add all of the ingredients to a jar.
Mix until smooth. The mixture might appear too thin at first, but just keep stirring! It will naturally thicken.
Pour over your favourite salad, toss to coat, and enjoy!

page_recipe_notes: Notes † Use golden tahini made from lightly toasted sesame seeds, rather than pale tahini made from raw seeds. † For us, 1 lemon yielded about 2 Tbsp (30 mL) of lemon juice.
Storage Store in an airtight container in the fridge for up to 4 days.
